<span class="hl-kw">from</span> __future__ <span class="hl-kw">import</span> annotations
<span class="hl-kw">from</span> dataclasses <span class="hl-kw">import</span> dataclass


<span class="hl-comment">@dataclass(frozen=True)</span>
<span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData:
    o: <span class="hl-type">str</span>
    nul: <span class="hl-type">str</span>
    arr: <span class="hl-type">str</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    empty: <span class="hl-type">str</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    <span class="hl-type">str</span>: <span class="hl-type">str</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>
    dup_keys: <span class="hl-type">str</span> = <span class="hl-kw">None</span>

    @classmethod
    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> from_dict(<span class="hl-kw">cls</span>, data: <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]) -&gt; UserCreatedData:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">cls</span>(
            o=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;o&quot;</span>),
            nul=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;nul&quot;</span>),
            arr=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;arr&quot;</span>),
            empty=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;empty&quot;</span>),
            <span class="hl-type">str</span>=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;str&quot;</span>),
            dup_keys=data.get(<span class="hl-str">&quot;dupKeys&quot;</span>),
        )

    <span class="hl-kw">def</span> to_dict(<span class="hl-kw">self</span>) -&gt; <span class="hl-type">dict</span>[<span class="hl-type">str</span>, <span class="hl-type">Any</span>]:
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> {
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;o&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.o,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;nul&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.nul,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;arr&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.arr,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;empty&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.empty,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;str&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.<span class="hl-type">str</span>,
            <span class="hl-str">&quot;dupKeys&quot;</span>: <span class="hl-kw">self</span>.dup_keys,
        }
